conventions.equilibrium_selection: None; limit fits compared only after time-side decisions
conventions.condition_and_range: Deterministic sensitivity diagnostics, not statistical confidence intervals
conventions.pilot_ranking: Same L72/108 and theta4-9 for all candidates, not certification; no equilibrium target or literature value
conventions.final_scale_screen: theta>=4 and theta/L<=0.05 for both compared sizes; an operational screen, not an asymptotic proof
conventions.missing_data: No confirmation data means candidate/unresolved, never a confirmed pass

comparison_rule: Time-side eligibility is evaluated without equilibrium. Numerical agreement requires time-side checks, stable equilibrium fits, <=5% relative endpoint difference and overlapping model/window sensitivity ranges; ranges are not confidence intervals. This is finite-window evidence, not an equality theorem.
